note: Run by scripts/vale-cases.test.js. Each case is linted as a Markdown file (or plain text with "ext": "txt"). `vale` is whether the rule alerts; `detector` is whether analyzeText reports the rule's type. A case where the two differ records a known difference, and `why` says what it is.

Transitions.text: Moreover, the team shipped the release a full week before the deadline.
We needed more time over the weekend to finish the release notes.
The style guide bans the word "Moreover, the plan" in every release note we ship.
Transitions.why: The detector masks double-quoted spans; Vale lints quoted prose.

Transitions.text:
The reviewer pasted a line from the draft.

> Moreover, the team shipped the release a full week early.

We rewrote it before publishing the notes.
Transitions.why: The detector strips blockquotes; Vale lints them.

Transitions.text: The linter flags the token `moreover` when it appears in any of our release notes.
Transitions.why: Vale skips code in Markdown; the detector reads it.

Transitions.text:
The fixture below holds the flagged word inside a code block.

```
Moreover, this line is code.
```

Nothing outside the block should alert at all.
Transitions.why: Vale skips code in Markdown; the detector reads it.

Transitions.text: More​over, the team shipped the release a full week before the deadline.
Transitions.why: The detector removes zero-width characters before matching; Vale does not.

ChatbotArtifacts.text: Here is the summary of the meeting notes you asked for. I hope this helps!
I hope the weather helps the farmers this season after such a dry spring.

Sycophancy.text: You're absolutely right, and the second option is the cheaper one for this team.
You are right about the cost, and the second option is cheaper for this team.

Fillers.text: It is important to note that the service restarts every night at two o'clock.
It is important that the service restarts every night at two o'clock sharp.
The plan is cheaper in terms of hosting and staff time for the whole year.
Fillers.why: JS \s matches a no-break space; in Vale the same pattern does not match it.

GenericConclusions.text: We closed the last open ticket on Friday, and only time will tell if it holds.
We closed the last open ticket on Friday, and the logs will tell us if it holds.

LetsOpeners.text: Let's explore how the cache behaves when two requests arrive at the same time.
Lets explorers camp near the river when the main trail is closed for the season.

ReasoningArtifacts.text: Let me think step by step about why the nightly backup job failed again.
Let me know step by step how you fixed the nightly backup job last week.

SignificanceInflation.text: The new release shipped on Tuesday, marking a pivotal moment for the support team.
The new release shipped on Tuesday, a busy moment for the whole support team.

VagueAttribution.text: Experts believe that the new database layout will cut query time in half.
Our two database experts measured the new layout and query time fell by half.

HollowIntensifiers.text: The new onboarding guide is truly helpful for people joining the support team.
The new onboarding guide is helpful for people joining the support team this month.

StockReactions.text: What surprised me most was how little the change affected the nightly build time.
The change surprised the team because it barely affected the nightly build time.

LingeringAttention.text: The line I keep coming back to is the one about paying down the old debt first.
The line we keep for returns is shorter than the one at the main checkout desk.

NoveltyInflation.text: This is a problem nobody talks about in planning meetings for the support team.
This is a problem the support team talks about in every single planning meeting.

CutoffDisclaimers.text: As of my last update, the library supported only the first two file formats.
As of the last update, the library supported only the first two file formats.

Placeholders.text: Thanks again for the call on Monday, and please send the signed form to [Your Name] soon.
Thanks again for the call on Monday, and please send the signed form to Dana soon.
Revenue grew four percent last year across all regions and costs held flat for us. <!-- TODO: add the source -->
Placeholders.why: Vale skips HTML comments in Markdown; the detector reads them.

CitationMarkup.text: The report says revenue grew by four percent last year. citeturn0search1 The rest is unchanged.
The report says revenue grew by four percent last year, citing two public filings.

UTMSource.text: The draft linked to https://example.test/guide?utm_source=chatgpt.com for the full setup guide.
The draft linked to https://example.test/guide?utm_source=newsletter for the full setup guide.
The draft linked to [the setup guide](https://example.test/guide?utm_source=chatgpt.com) for the whole team today.


Run it once on each new laptop.

TemplatePhrases.text: Moving the build to the new runners is a major step forward for the whole team.
Moving the build to the new runners took a major step of planning for the team.

FalseConcession.text: While the new parser is impressive in many ways, error recovery remains a challenge for us.
The new parser is fast in many ways, and its error recovery got better this month too.

RhetoricalQuestions.text: The vendor raised prices again this quarter. So why should you care about any of it?
The vendor raised prices again this quarter, so we moved two services to another host.

HedgeStack.text: The new index could potentially reduce the time each nightly report takes to build.
The new index could reduce the time each nightly report takes to build by a third.

FutureNarrative.text: Local inference on laptops could become one of the most important trends for small teams.
Local inference on laptops became cheap enough for small teams to try this spring.

RealActualInflation.text: The token finally has real utility now that the payment partners accept it at checkout.
The token is finally useful now that the payment partners accept it at checkout.

EngagementBait.text: The talk covers how the team cut cloud costs in half. This one is worth your time.
The talk covers how the team cut cloud costs in half over one long quarter of work.

PerformedInsight.text: Half the alerts last month came from one flaky test. Sit with that for a moment.
Half the alerts last month came from one flaky test, so we sat with the owner to fix it.

NegationChain.text: The new plan is simple. No meetings, no slides, no status reports for the rest of the month.
The new plan is simple. No meetings this week, and short status reports for the rest of the month.
Don't just read it once on your phone; just read it again at your desk tomorrow.

NegativeParallelism.text: The outage wasn't just a config error, it was a gap in how we review every change.
The outage was a config error, and we added a review step for every change after it.

DevBlogBoilerplate.text: Install the package, add one line to your config file, and it just works on every platform.
Install the package, add one line to your config file, and it runs on every platform we test.

FormulaicOpeners.text: In the rapidly evolving world of web hosting, small teams need simple deploy tools.
In the world of web hosting, small teams need simple deploy tools that do not break.

SpeculativeOpeners.text: Imagine a world where every deploy finishes in under a minute for the whole team.
Imagine the deploy finishing in under a minute for the whole team on a busy Friday.

LaunchIntros.text: Our new tool is out today. Think Figma meets Postgres, built for small product teams.
Our new tool is out today. I think the Figma plugin works with Postgres for small teams.

CrowdContrast.text: While everyone else was still debating the spec, our team shipped a working version.
While the other team reviewed the spec, our team shipped a working version on Friday.

FakeCasualProps.text: The new build is three times faster (yes, really) on the old laptops we still use.
The new build is three times faster (we measured it) on the old laptops we still use.
The new build is three times faster *checks notes* on the old laptops we still use.
FakeCasualProps.why: In Markdown the asterisks are emphasis markup, so Vale never sees them; the detector reads the raw text.

FakeCasualProps.text: The new build is three times faster *checks notes* on the old laptops we still use.

ParentheticalHedges.text: The new cache helps most on cold starts (and increasingly on warm ones as well).
The new cache helps most on cold starts (about forty percent) and a little on warm ones.

UnnecessaryHyphenation.text: We moved the whole code-base to the new build system over two quiet weeks in June.
We moved the whole codebase to the new build system over two quiet weeks in June.
The script reads src/code-base/index.js and writes the bundle into the dist folder.
UnnecessaryHyphenation.why: The detector masks file paths and identifiers before matching; Vale does not.

Tier1Vocabulary.text: The new layout gives the team a robust way to review changes before each release.
The new layout gives the team a reliable way to review changes before each release.
The old layout gave the team a non-robust way to review changes before each release.
Tier1Vocabulary.why: The detector matches whole tokens split on [\w'-]+, so 'non-robust' is one token; Vale matches 'robust' inside it.

Tier1Phrases.text: In this post we delve into how the team cut the nightly build time in half.
In this post we look at how the team cut the nightly build time in half this year.

Tier1Clarity.text: We split the job into two steps in order to keep each nightly run under an hour.
We split the job into two steps to keep each nightly run under an hour on the old server.

Tier2Vocabulary.text: The new tools help us streamline reviews and empower each team to ship changes faster.
The new tools help us streamline reviews so each team can ship its changes faster.
Tier2Vocabulary.why: The detector needs two distinct Tier 2 words in one paragraph; Vale alerts on each word.

Tier2Vocabulary.text: The new tools help us speed up reviews so each team can ship its changes faster.

ConfidenceStacking.text: Interestingly, the plan held. Surprisingly, so did the budget. It was certainly a relief for everyone.
Interestingly, the plan held. Surprisingly, so did the budget for the rest of the long year.

occurrence.note: One case pair per occurrence rule, generated by the test: `fire` uses the term at the rule's threshold, `near-miss` one time fewer. Terms for the phrase rules are listed here because a phrase cannot be read back from its regex.

boundaryFrom.note: Cases written for the draft export contract. Their `detector` field is checked as written; `vale` is recorded here.
